description: Generate robots.txt User-agent rules for all known AI crawlers from a chosen policy (max_visibility, search_only, block_training, block_all_ai), with optional Content-Signal and Sitemap lines, to paste into an existing robots.txt. Use when writing AI crawler rules. Do NOT use to check a live site's current rules (use check_ai_readiness) or for bot background (use crawler_policy_guide).

content_signals.description: Append a Content-Signal line (search / ai-input / ai-train) matching the policy. Default true; pass false to omit.

policy.description: AI policy preset: max_visibility = allow every AI bot; search_only or block_training = allow search/answer bots, block training crawlers (same output); block_all_ai = disallow every known AI bot.

sitemap_url.description: Optional absolute sitemap URL appended as a Sitemap: line, e.g. https://example.com/sitemap.xml.

name: robots_txt_for_ai

disclaimer.description: Informational disclaimer: crawler behaviour can change, verify against provider docs.

notes.description: Guidance on merging and interpreting the rules.

policy.description: The policy preset the rules were generated for.

title: Generate robots.txt for AI
